biography.value:
Hippogryph Knight. A major presence from the Kingdom of Bretonnia, built for brutal, legible table play. Its numbers are recalibrated from a PF2e-style creature benchmark and mapped back onto D&D challenge expectations.

Rules Profile. AC 18; HP 226; proficiency +5; save DC 17. Linked armory entries: 16. Linked spell entries: 0.

"A warrior is measured when the line begins to break."
- Old World battlefield saying

source.book: Warhammer: The Old World x D&D 5e
